note: Fallen-angel names are proposed as MANAGED VERTICALS, not stock buys (2026-07-14): a bull-put credit spread on every name with score>=spread_min_score, plus a bull-call debit spread when score>=call_min_score (the backtested differentiator). Strikes: put short ~put_short_otm below spot / long put_width_otm lower; call long ~ATM / short call_short_otm above; nearest monthly ~spread_target_dte DTE. max_loss (2026-08-23): hard $ cap on both spread types -- any candidate whose computed max loss (width-credit for the put spread, debit paid for the call spread) exceeds this is skipped, not proposed. Widths narrowed same day (put_width_otm 0.07->0.04, call_short_otm 0.08->0.05) so the cap isn't doing all the work on pricier names. HITL Slack Take button re-prices live and submits an MLEG order -- FIXED 2026-08-23: the vertical Take button now encodes the full order (ticker/kind/expiry/strikes/net) directly in the button value instead of a pending_store lookup id, so it survives a Render redeploy between the alert posting and the tap (same fix already applied to the fa_buy/close_ticker buttons; the vertical Take button was added later and had been missing it -- this is almost certainly why taps weren't taking trades). value_buy_enabled=false: Value Watchlist BUYs OFF pending review (rank backtested inversely). Legacy stock-buy rules below still drive _fa_manage_job for any existing share positions. Risk-based sizing: shares = (risk_pct_per_position * equity) / (entry - stop), capped at max_position_pct of equity, max_positions concurrent, and total category exposure <= max_category_pct of equity. Stop = the HIGHER (first-triggered) of entry*(1-stop_drawdown_pct) and 52w_low*(1-stop_below_52w_low_pct) -> encodes 'new 52w low OR -12%'. A protective sell-stop is placed at the broker on entry. Exit (trim half at +trim_at_gain_pct, then trail_pct trailing stop) is managed by _fa_manage_job.
